_purpose: Declarative list of topics the agent must refuse, and where each refusal routes. Referenced by skills/answer-or-refuse.md. Tested by evals/refusal-suite.json.
_what_this_is_not: This is NOT a runtime interceptor. Nothing here inspects a live conversation. It is (a) the single declared source the answer-or-refuse skill reads from, so the boundary list is not restated in prose and cannot drift, and (b) a testable artifact so the eval suite can prove every must-refuse case maps to a declared boundary. The keyword triggers are a coverage aid for testing, not a classifier the agent's safety depends on. See docs/test-strategy.md, gap TG-01.
_routing_policy: The org chart is an empty template. No boundary may route to a named person or an assumed team. Every route points at a SLOT in knowledge/internal/, and the agent must state plainly that the slot is unfilled.

boundaries.description: Internal tools, systems, URLs, logins, wikis, ticketing, or how to access any of them.
Names of managers, teammates, leadership, reporting lines, team structure, or who owns what.
The actual first-day checklist: laptop pickup, account activation, required forms, intro meetings, first-week schedule.
Who to contact for HR, IT, payroll, security, facilities, or a buddy/mentor assignment.
Internal policies, code of conduct, infosec policy, acceptable use, confidentiality, customer data handling, remote work, time off, and any compliance instruction.
boundaries.source: PACK must-not-pretend list + PACK guardrail on compliance instructions

boundaries.description: Security procedures, incident response, access requests, credential handling, or any instruction with a security consequence.
Role-specific ramp expectations, 30/60/90 plans, what the hire's manager expects, or performance criteria.
Compensation, equity, payroll specifics, and benefits enrollment. Public careers messaging (ALT-011) may be acknowledged as messaging but never used to answer an enrollment or entitlement question.
Employment advice, workplace disputes, concerns about a colleague or manager, performance worries, or anything an HR partner would handle.
Legal advice, contracts, visa or immigration status, right-to-work questions.
Any investment, tax, or financial advice — for the hire personally, for a client, or as a worked recommendation. The agent explains what platform features do; it never advises.
boundaries.route_label: a licensed professional; this agent does not advise
boundaries.source: audit F4; PACK guardrail on operational instructions

boundaries.description: Internal architecture, service boundaries, model stack, prompts, permissions, evaluation methods, deploy or on-call practice, incident history, roadmap, customer data flows.
boundaries.route_label: an engineering owner; not knowable from public sources
boundaries.source: PACK must-not-pretend list; PACK Hazel boundary

boundaries.description: Who approves what, especially for anything compliance-touching. The agent must never name or infer an approver.
boundaries.source: audit critical finding 2 — the old plan's enforcement rule 5 mandated fabrication here

boundaries.description: Any topic whose only support is the old plan: entity structure, regulatory specifics beyond ALT-027, funding, valuation, AUM, market share, rankings, named clients, Hazel dates or pricing or subscriber counts, headcount, advisor segment names, competitor names.

Requests to confirm, guarantee, or put in writing that client data is safe, encrypted, or not used for training. ALT-028 may be described as published messaging; it may never be given as an assurance, and never to a client or prospect.
boundaries.source: audit K2.11; PACK guardrail that marketing copy is positioning not proof
triggers: is client data used to train

_answerable_note: 'regulatory' and 'hazel-security' appear here because ALT-027 and ALT-028 are answerable as attributed public messaging. Both carry sensitive=true in factbase.json, which forces the attribution wrapper, and both have refusing boundaries (B-15, and B-14 for the quarantined specifics) that cover the dangerous forms of those questions.
